WITH expansion AS (
 SELECT owner_versions FROM execution_input_expansions WHERE project_id=$1 AND set_id=$2
), freshness AS (
 SELECT count(*)>$6 AND bool_and(COALESCE(p.validity_version=owner.value::bigint,$7)) AS fresh
 FROM expansion CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(owner_versions) owner
 LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.project_id=owner.key::uuid
), conditions AS (
 SELECT r.*,CASE WHEN $3 THEN r.purpose ELSE $4 END AS check_purpose,
   m.role,
   a.revision_id AS artifact_found, a.artifact_id, a.kind AS artifact_kind,
   runtime.record_id AS runtime_found, runtime.record_kind AS runtime_kind,
   b.storage_key AS blob_found,b.sha256,b.byte_length,b.media_type,
   pub.publication_id AS publication_found,pub.config
 FROM execution_input_resources r
 LEFT JOIN project_members m ON m.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND m.actor_id=$5
 LEFT JOIN artifact_revisions a ON r.resource_kind=$8
   AND a.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND a.revision_id=CASE WHEN r.resource_kind=$9 THEN r.identity::uuid END
 LEFT JOIN runtime_records runtime ON r.resource_kind=$10
   AND runtime.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND runtime.record_id=CASE WHEN r.resource_kind=$11 THEN r.identity::uuid END
 LEFT JOIN blobs b ON r.resource_kind=$12
   AND b.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND b.storage_key=r.identity
 LEFT JOIN catalog_publications pub ON r.resource_kind=$13
   AND pub.project_id=r.owner_project_id AND pub.publication_id=CASE WHEN r.resource_kind=$14 THEN r.identity::uuid END
 WHERE r.project_id=$1 AND r.set_id=$2 AND ($3 OR r.purpose=$4)
)
SELECT (SELECT fresh FROM freshness) AS fresh,
 NOT EXISTS(SELECT $15 FROM conditions c WHERE CASE c.resource_kind
 WHEN $16 THEN c.role IS NULL OR (c.identity=$17 AND (c.check_purpose<>$18 OR c.role NOT IN ($19,$20,$21)))
 WHEN $22 THEN c.artifact_found IS NULL
   OR c.artifact_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$23
   OR c.artifact_kind IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$24
   OR EXISTS(SELECT $25 FROM invalidations i WHERE i.project_id=c.owner_project_id
      AND i.revision_id=c.artifact_found AND i.category=$26)
 WHEN $27 THEN c.runtime_found IS NULL OR c.runtime_kind IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$28
   OR EXISTS(SELECT $29 FROM execution_record_withdrawals w WHERE w.project_id=c.owner_project_id AND w.record_id=c.runtime_found)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT $30 FROM semantic_execution_links l JOIN execution_entries e USING(project_id,entry_id)
      WHERE l.project_id=c.owner_project_id AND l.runtime_record_id=c.runtime_found
        AND (EXISTS(SELECT $31 FROM execution_entry_denials d
          WHERE d.project_id=e.project_id AND d.entry_id=e.entry_id)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT $32 FROM blob_access_revocations v
          WHERE v.project_id=e.project_id AND v.sha256=ANY(e.owned_hashes))))
 WHEN $33 THEN c.blob_found IS NULL OR c.sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$34
   OR c.byte_length IS DISTINCT FROM (c.binding->>$35)::bigint
   OR c.media_type IS DISTINCT FROM c.binding->>$36
   OR EXISTS(SELECT $37 FROM blob_access_revocations v WHERE v.project_id=c.owner_project_id
      AND v.sha256=c.binding->>$38)
   OR (c.read_required AND EXISTS(SELECT $39 FROM protected_byte_hashes e
      WHERE e.project_id=c.owner_project_id AND e.sha256=c.binding->>$40)
      AND (c.check_purpose<>$41 OR c.role IS NULL OR c.role NOT IN ($42,$43,$44)))
 WHEN $45 THEN c.publication_found IS NULL
   OR NOT(c.config->$46 ? (c.binding->>$47))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT $48 FROM catalog_revocations v WHERE v.publication_id=c.publication_found)
 ELSE $49 END) AS allowed

WITH permitted AS (SELECT m.source_id,c.start_offset,c.end_offset,c.language,c.lexical,c.exact_terms,c.phrase_text,c.embedding,c.passage_sha256 FROM source_search_memberships m JOIN source_search_documents d ON d.project_id=m.project_id AND d.document_key=m.document_key JOIN source_search_document_chunks c ON c.project_id=d.project_id AND c.document_key=d.document_key WHERE m.project_id=$1 AND m.shared_input_record_id=$2 AND m.profile_sha256=$3 AND m.source_id=ANY($4) AND d.completed) , scored AS (SELECT source_id,start_offset,end_offset,passage_sha256,((strpos($8||phrase_text||$9,$5)>$10)::int + (SELECT count(*)::float FROM unnest(CAST($6 AS text[])) AS e(term) WHERE e.term=ANY(exact_terms))/GREATEST(cardinality(CAST($6 AS text[])),$11)) AS score FROM permitted WHERE strpos($12||phrase_text||$13,$5)>$14 OR exact_terms && CAST($6 AS text[])), selected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT passage_sha256,max(score) AS score,min(source_id) AS first_source,min(start_offset) AS first_start FROM scored GROUP BY passage_sha256 ORDER BY score DESC,first_source,first_start,passage_sha256 LIMIT $7) SELECT s.passage_sha256,s.score,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($15,p.source_id,$16,p.start_offset,$17,p.end_offset) ORDER BY p.source_id,p.start_offset,p.end_offset) AS aliases FROM selected s JOIN permitted p ON p.passage_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.passage_sha256 GROUP BY s.passage_sha256,s.score,s.first_source,s.first_start ORDER BY s.score DESC,s.first_source,s.first_start,s.passage_sha256

WITH permitted AS (SELECT m.source_id,c.start_offset,c.end_offset,c.language,c.lexical,c.exact_terms,c.phrase_text,c.embedding,c.passage_sha256 FROM source_search_memberships m JOIN source_search_documents d ON d.project_id=m.project_id AND d.document_key=m.document_key JOIN source_search_document_chunks c ON c.project_id=d.project_id AND c.document_key=d.document_key WHERE m.project_id=$1 AND m.shared_input_record_id=$2 AND m.profile_sha256=$3 AND m.source_id=ANY($4) AND d.completed) , scored AS (SELECT source_id,start_offset,end_offset,passage_sha256,ts_rank_cd(lexical,websearch_to_tsquery(CASE language WHEN $7 THEN $8::regconfig WHEN $9 THEN $10::regconfig ELSE $11::regconfig END,$5)) AS score FROM permitted WHERE lexical @@ websearch_to_tsquery(CASE language WHEN $12 THEN $13::regconfig WHEN $14 THEN $15::regconfig ELSE $16::regconfig END,$5)), selected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT passage_sha256,max(score) AS score,min(source_id) AS first_source,min(start_offset) AS first_start FROM scored GROUP BY passage_sha256 ORDER BY score DESC,first_source,first_start,passage_sha256 LIMIT $6) SELECT s.passage_sha256,s.score,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($17,p.source_id,$18,p.start_offset,$19,p.end_offset) ORDER BY p.source_id,p.start_offset,p.end_offset) AS aliases FROM selected s JOIN permitted p ON p.passage_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.passage_sha256 GROUP BY s.passage_sha256,s.score,s.first_source,s.first_start ORDER BY s.score DESC,s.first_source,s.first_start,s.passage_sha256

WITH permitted AS (SELECT m.source_id,c.start_offset,c.end_offset,c.language,c.lexical,c.exact_terms,c.phrase_text,c.embedding,c.passage_sha256 FROM source_search_memberships m JOIN source_search_documents d ON d.project_id=m.project_id AND d.document_key=m.document_key JOIN source_search_document_chunks c ON c.project_id=d.project_id AND c.document_key=d.document_key WHERE m.project_id=$1 AND m.shared_input_record_id=$2 AND m.profile_sha256=$3 AND m.source_id=ANY($4) AND d.completed) , scored AS (SELECT source_id,start_offset,end_offset,passage_sha256,$7-(embedding <=> CAST($5 AS vector)) AS score FROM permitted), selected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT passage_sha256,max(score) AS score,min(source_id) AS first_source,min(start_offset) AS first_start FROM scored GROUP BY passage_sha256 ORDER BY score DESC,first_source,first_start,passage_sha256 LIMIT $6) SELECT s.passage_sha256,s.score,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($8,p.source_id,$9,p.start_offset,$10,p.end_offset) ORDER BY p.source_id,p.start_offset,p.end_offset) AS aliases FROM selected s JOIN permitted p ON p.passage_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.passage_sha256 GROUP BY s.passage_sha256,s.score,s.first_source,s.first_start ORDER BY s.score DESC,s.first_source,s.first_start,s.passage_sha256

SELECT r.project_id,r.revision_id,r.artifact_id,r.kind,r.input_refs,r.audience,
    CASE WHEN r.kind=$2 THEN r.payload->>$3 END AS catalog_voice_kind,
    jsonb_build_object(
        $4,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) FROM artifact_dependencies e
            WHERE e.project_id=r.project_id AND e.consumer_id=r.revision_id),$5::jsonb),
        $6,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(d.payload::jsonb
            ORDER BY (d.payload->>$7)::bigint)
            FROM dependency_revalidations d WHERE d.project_id=r.project_id AND d.subject_id=r.revision_id
            AND (d.acceptance_record_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT $8 FROM revocations v
                WHERE v.project_id=d.project_id AND v.acceptance_record_id=d.acceptance_record_id))),
            $9::jsonb),
        $10,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(l.input_id) FROM revalidation_privacy_links l
            WHERE l.project_id=r.project_id AND l.subject_id=r.revision_id),$11::jsonb),
        $12,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b)||jsonb_build_object(
            $13,a.purpose,
            $14,EXISTS(SELECT $15 FROM blob_access_revocations v
                WHERE v.project_id=b.project_id AND v.sha256=b.sha256),
            $16,EXISTS(SELECT $17 FROM protected_byte_hashes c
                WHERE c.project_id=b.project_id AND c.sha256=b.sha256)))
            FROM artifact_blobs a JOIN blobs b USING(project_id,storage_key)
            WHERE a.project_id=r.project_id AND a.revision_id=r.revision_id),$18::jsonb),
        $19,EXISTS(SELECT $20 FROM invalidations i WHERE i.project_id=r.project_id
            AND i.revision_id=r.revision_id AND i.category=$21)
            OR EXISTS(SELECT $22 FROM semantic_execution_links l JOIN execution_entry_denials d
                USING(project_id,entry_id)
                WHERE l.project_id=r.project_id AND l.artifact_revision_id=r.revision_id),
        $23,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            $24,l.record_id,$25,l.record_kind)) FROM runtime_links l
            WHERE l.project_id=r.project_id AND l.revision_id=r.revision_id AND l.read_required),$26::jsonb)
    ) AS access_graph
FROM artifact_revisions r WHERE r.revision_id=ANY($1)

method.native_request_comparison: Exact canonical payloads except existing benchmark substitutions for run metadata and opaque catalog/result version hashes.
method.server_totals: Top-level includes nested work; never add durations or block counts.
method.cold_read: Additional cold outcome read is excluded from complete-operation totals.
